terms.note: Executing a trained model; distinguish it from reasoning through a problem.
Problem solving or reasoning behavior, not every model forward pass.
A provider-specific control, not a universal token limit.
Keep the distinction between sequential reasoning, candidates, and verification.
Distinguish visible explanations, private reasoning, and opaque continuation items.
Information made available to a model for a particular invocation.
Selecting and assembling task-relevant context under explicit constraints.
Do not equate a saved record with the complete state of the outside world.
Specify the storage, scope, lifetime, and retrieval mechanism.
The execution support around an agent; do not conflate it with a model or SDK.
A workflow may include model calls without giving a model control of every transition.
Distinguish a model's proposed call from authorization and execution.
Associate results with the actual call identifier.
Keep API schema keys and protocol literals unchanged.
Explain the required structure and meaning instead of relying on the term alone.
Do not translate this as recall, which can name a metric.
State the denominator and relevance definition when used as a metric.
A stage that orders candidates; it is not an independent retrieval architecture.
Use evidence grounding or visual grounding according to the actual task.
Explain what the answer or explanation is expected to be faithful to.
Do not equate it with consistency with a supplied but incorrect document.
Identify the task, dataset, criteria, and conditions.
Separate business acceptance from a passing unit test.
Use release gate or authorization check when that is the actual mechanism.
Distinguish another execution candidate from reduced functionality.
Reduced service must still respect authorization and safety constraints.
Do not equate retrying or checkpointing with exactly-once effects.
Distinguish runtime recovery from model-training checkpoints.
Distinguish trace, span, session, and raw private reasoning.
Specify the source and transformations rather than using an abstract slogan.
Permission to act on a resource; not authentication or model confidence.
Establishing identity does not grant every action.
State the decision a person makes and the enforcement point.
An isolation mechanism, not a substitute for authorization.
Do not mechanically translate every use of 线上 as online.
Name what is collected and which decision changes; avoid empty closed-loop rhetoric.
For 口径, choose definition, units, scope, or accounting rules as appropriate; never caliber.
Name the reusable artifact; do not translate 沉淀 literally.
